items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t appreciate Johnny Hodges until years later. Of course now I just think he’s magnificent.

ctx.x: I didn’t like the timbre of the instrument. It didn’t touch me. I didn’t fall in love with the alto. I like Louis Jordan. He was one. I heard an alto player named Pete Brown that played like a boogie-woogie alto. I liked him too. But I didn’t like the sweet alto. I didn’t appreciate Johnny Hodges until years later. Of course now I just think he’s magnificent.
